title: Solutions + Pro Services Weekly Sync Notes - 2026-07-14
content:
Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Liam Chen (solutions eng), Sofia Martinez (pro services PM), Ethan Brown (infra lead), Priya Rao (SRE/ops), + guests from Acme and BetaBank as noted.

Agenda:
- Quick rundowns: active customer integrations + POCs
- Blockers / infra scheduling
- Rollout & cutover windows for Dedicated/Private deployments
- Action items and owners

Notes / Customer status updates:

1) Acme Corp (POC - Hosted -> Dedicated pilot)
- Status: Demo went well on 7/10; Acme wants to move to a short Dedicated pilot to validate latency at scale for their search assistant.
- Tech details: using redwood/model-3-medium, request patterns ~95% short context (<=256 tokens). Expect sustained 120 rps during business hours.
- Open blockers: procurement needs a short contract amendment for data retention and SLAs (Sofia to own). Network: customer requires IP allowlist + egress logging; infra needs static egress IP config for Dedicated env (Ethan).
- Next steps: schedule Dedicated capacity window (2x A100 equiv) for pilot week 2026-07-27 -> Liam to coordinate with infra scheduling and capacity planner.
- Action items:
  - Sofia: Draft pilot SOW + contract addendum, due 2026-07-17.
  - Ethan: Confirm static egress IP approach and ETA, due 2026-07-16.
  - Liam: Prepare canary workload and perf test script, due 2026-07-20.

2) BetaBank (Private deployment - VPC peering + KMS integration)
- Status: Security review passed with minor comments; KMS integration work started.
- Tech details: Customer needs HSM-backed keys and audit logs; expecting M-F 9–6 peak with mid-month batch jobs (higher token count).
- Open blockers: KMS provider asked for additional handshake logs; pro services needs to add HSM key rotation doc to runbook. Also, the customer's network team flagged MTU issues with the established VPN route.
- Next steps: Priya to run end-to-end key rotation test in staging by 7/21. Solutions eng to provide runbook draft for audit by 7/19.
- Action items:
  - Priya: End-to-end KMS test in staging and capture logs, due 2026-07-21.
  - Aisha: Draft runbook and rotation playbook, share with BetaBank security, due 2026-07-19.
  - Sofia: Follow up on MTU investigation with BetaBank networking, due 2026-07-16.

3) HealthSys (On-prem / air-gapped PO)
- Status: Proof-of-concept for on-prem package installation completed last week at a test site. Customer provided feedback about disk IO and nvme requirement.
- Tech details: On-prem instance will use quantized weights (int8) for cost; initial benchmarks show 7–12% quality delta on a small eval set. Research/Applied-ML engaged to tune quantization profile.
- Open blockers: HealthSys requires an offline-bundle install path (no internet) and formal acceptance test criteria. Also need legal sign-off for offline support SLA.
- Next steps: Engineering to produce offline bundle image and acceptance test checklist by 7/24. Research to re-run evals with updated quant profile by 7/22.
- Action items:
  - Ethan: Build offline image prototype + install script, due 2026-07-24.
  - Priya: Draft acceptance test checklist and failure modes, due 2026-07-20.
  - Research (assigned: Marco Alvarez): Re-evaluate quant profile and report, due 2026-07-22.

4) OmniRetail (embedding / retriever optimization)
- Status: Early integration; customer seeing high embedding costs. Solutions team recommended cached prefix embeddings and index sharding.
- Tech details: Using embeddings endpoint for product search; embedding dimensionality 1024, QPS spiky during sales events.
- Open blockers: Need an automated caching layer to avoid repeated embedding calls for near-duplicates. Product ask: expose per-route embedding TTL controls in the Console.
- Action items:
  - Liam: Prototype prefix caching at the proxy layer, due 2026-07-28.
  - Product: Ticket to track per-route embedding TTL (product-hosted-api), PROJ-342 created.

Cross-cutting blockers / risks:
- Capacity: July end calendar is packed with Dedicated pilots (Acme, two internal load tests). Need to confirm extra 2 GPU pool availability or night/weekend scheduling. (Ethan to confirm with infra by 7/16).
- Model regressions: HealthSys quantization tests flagged a small-but-noticeable drop on edge cases (PROD risk). Research to produce comparator evals and recommend mitigations (fallback to full precision for critical prompts).
- Networking: VPN/MTU issues with BetaBank; may require carrier changes or different tunneling approach.
- Contracts: Procurement delays could push pilots into August if SOWs not signed this week.

Operational notes / runbook updates:
- Add KMS rotation playbook to "runbooks/onprem-kms-rotation.md" and link from Private deployment onboarding doc.
- Update Dedicated capacity scheduler to allow 'pilot-preemption' tags for short-term pilots.

Decisions made:
- Pilot cadence: Approve Acme pilot for 1-week Dedicated trial with possible 1-week extension pending perf results.
- HealthSys: proceed with on-prem offline bundle but add mandatory acceptance test before GA.

Action items (summary):
- Sofia Martinez: Draft pilot SOW & contract addendum for Acme (due 2026-07-17).
- Ethan Brown: Confirm static egress IP approach + infra scheduling (due 2026-07-16).
- Liam Chen: Canary perf test + proxy caching prototype (due 2026-07-20 & 2026-07-28).
- Priya Rao: KMS rotation testing & acceptance checklist support (due 2026-07-21 & 2026-07-20).
- Aisha Patel: Runbook drafts for KMS rotation and on-prem acceptance (due 2026-07-19 & 2026-07-24).
- Marco Alvarez (Research): Re-evaluate quantization profile for HealthSys (due 2026-07-22).

Notes to self / loose threads:
- Follow up on INFRA-118 for VPN MTU workaround options.
- Confirm whether we should expose embedding TTL controls in Console beta or as a workaround via API headers first.
- Customer feedback: request Acme to provide 2-week anonymized logs for prefix caching analysis.

Meeting closed: 11:05am PT. Next sync: 2026-07-21 (weekly).
